notes: Pyongyang 2015 (Commons: Shops in Pyongyang / Signs in North Korea): vertical light-box with a beer-mug pictogram, hung on a green DPRK apartment block; Hangul written top to bottom, one syllable per row. Names the beer bar after the DPRK's Taedonggang brand. Small unreadable signs further along the facade are distractors.

author: Jan Engelhardt
attribution: Photo: Jan Engelhardt, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Luminous_sign_in_North_Korea.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Night, North Korea (Tongdaewon is a Pyongyang district): gold 3-D letters on a brick facade framed by coloured LED strips, shot upward. Distractor: red LED opening-hours ticker '봉사시간: 오전8시부터 저녁21시까지' in DPRK wording (봉사시간 = service hours). No GPS in the source; country from the Commons title.
